WITH state_filter AS (
    SELECT ca_address_sk FROM customer_address WHERE ca_state IN ('IL', 'TX', 'ME')
),
date_filter AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2002 AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3
),
store_sales_cte AS (
    SELECT ss_customer_sk FROM store_sales WHERE ss_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_filter)
),
web_sales_cte AS (
    SELECT ws_bill_customer_sk FROM web_sales WHERE ws_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_filter)
),
catalog_sales_cte AS (
    SELECT cs_ship_customer_sk FROM catalog_sales WHERE cs_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_filter)
),
sales_flags AS (
    SELECT 
        c.c_customer_sk,
        MAX(CASE WHEN ss.ss_customer_sk IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_store_sales,
        MAX(CASE WHEN ws.ws_bill_customer_sk IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_web_sales,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cs.cs_ship_customer_sk IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_catalog_sales
    FROM customer c
    LEFT JOIN store_sales_cte ss ON c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_sales_cte ws ON c.c_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_sales_cte cs ON c.c_customer_sk = cs.cs_ship_customer_sk
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk
)
SELECT 
    cd_gender, 
    cd_marital_status, 
    cd_education_status, 
    COUNT(*) cnt1,
    cd_purchase_estimate, 
    COUNT(*) cnt2,
    cd_credit_rating, 
    COUNT(*) cnt3
FROM customer_demographics cd
JOIN sales_flags sf ON cd.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk AND sf.c_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
WHERE has_store_sales = 1 AND has_web_sales = 0 AND has_catalog_sales = 0
GROUP BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating
ORDER BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating
LIMIT 100
